thread:
alex: Heads-up — ArmorCo just dropped a security evidence packet for the Acme POC. CAIQ + attachments in the zip. Can someone claim this?
priya: I'll take the CAIQ answers. ETA tomorrow EOD. Need network topology and KMS details from infra.
sam: @ingrid can you confirm whether customer will provide any raw PII? Also, pricing asked about reserved vs burst for the POC.
ingrid: @sam they said hashed IDs only, no raw PII. Uploading SOW and the addendum they signed.
risk-bot: New evidence uploaded by ingrid: armorco_evidence.zip (3 files). Link: https://drive.example/armorco_evidence.zip :package: 
priya: Got the zip. Quick scan — KMS and key management questions are unanswered. We'll need infra to confirm whether Dedicated pool has HSM or BYOK support.
alex: Who can own KMS confirmation? @maria from infra/risk?
maria: I can handle KMS Qs. Confirm: POC will run on Dedicated capacity (customer requested isolation). Need to know whether dedicated nodes include HSMs or only software-based keys.
ingrid: Confirmed with SalesOps — POC is on Dedicated. Customer requested isolated GPU pool, noted in the deal.
priya: I'll mark those CAIQ items as "requires infra confirmation" and put placeholders referencing this thread. That keeps progress visible to the customer.
sam: FYI pricing: customer also asked for a short note on reserved vs burst pricing for evaluation. Sales is drafting the price note and looping Legal for addendum terms.
ingrid: Pushed the pricing note to CS rep and attached our previous bank-template answers as reference: /templates/banking_caig_answers.md
priya: Plan: finish draft answers by tomorrow 18:00 PT. If infra can't confirm KMS by 15:00, we'll flag to the customer with a mitigation plan.
alex: @ingrid please set owner in Zendesk ticket #5832 to priya and add tag `security-evidence:armorco`.
ingrid: Done — ticket #5832 updated, owner=priya, tag added, milestone 'CAIQ draft to customer' set (due 2026-03-22).
maria: Quick note: our Dedicated pools can optionally mount HSM-backed KMS; not all customers enable it. I'll check whether this particular cluster has HSM. If not, I'll outline the BYOK alternatives.
priya: Perfect. If HSM not available we'll leave written mitigation and next-steps (partner BYOK or dedicated HSM attach).
sam: Blocker: customer requested recent pentest report and SOC2 mapping. Can infosec share redacted artifacts?
infosec: I will upload a redacted pentest PDF and a SOC2 controls mapping doc to the drive in 30m. I'll also add a short cover statement we can include in the CAIQ.
priya: Once I have the KMS confirmation + pentest link I'll finalize the CAIQ and ping the customer with the draft.
appingrid: small reminder — Legal needs the addendum signed before the POC start. If the CAIQ answers delay, Legal might push start dates. Escalating if we hit delays.
alex: Thanks everyone. Priya, ping here when the draft is ready and I'll do a quick product review before we send. :thumbsup:
